## What's Changed * sign-in after starting offline without crashing [#534](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/534) * improve sign-in text and error handling [#543](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/543) * enable SSL verification [#546](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/546) * respect history in more keyframe cases to avoid infinite loops of dreams [#545](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/545) * correctly update the scheduled ending time for the dream as playback speed changes to avoid fading to black [#446](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/446) * upload the dSYM file with the debug symbols to bugsnag so we can better understand errors reported from the field. * protect against missing dream FPS string [#542](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/542)
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/compare/0.14.7...0.14.8
